spec.description: A centred equation with Expanding above an upper curved arrow pointing right, and Factorising below a lower curved arrow pointing left.
spec.mathematics: 3(2x + 5) = 6x + 15. Expanding proceeds from the factorised expression to the expanded expression; factorising reverses that operation.
spec.answerVisibility: The equation, labels and both arrows are permanent teaching content.
